description_zh: 小米自帶線充電寶20000mAh 67W，真正嘅「一線走天涯」出行神器！內置USB-C自帶線，獨特收納槽設計一拉即用，唔使周圍搵線。支持67W MAX疾速輸出，30分鐘為Xiaomi 15充入67%電量；65W MAX高速自充，約2.5小時就可為充電寶自身充滿，出門更省時。配備3個接口（自帶線+USB-C+USB-A），可同時為三部裝置充電，無論手機、平板、筆記本、Switch定耳機，一次過搞掂。內置3顆6700mAh高品質電芯，等效20000mAh大容量（額定12000mAh），額定能量74.37Wh，符合國際航空標準，可帶上飛機。智能數顯屏幕，實時顯示剩餘電量（精準到個位）、充電狀態及小電流模式，電量唔使靠估。支持PD3.0/QC3.5/PPS等多種快充協議，兼容小米、華為、蘋果、三星、OPPO/vivo等主流手機及多款筆記本平板。雙擊電源鍵可開啟小電流模式，為手環、藍牙耳機充電更安全。九重安全防護（過充/過放/過壓/短路/溫度保護等）加上雙NTC感測器智慧控溫，快充同時保持冷靜唔燙手。手感温潤，體積適中單手可握，無論日常通勤、出差旅行，都係你嘅隨身電量救星！可充筆記本、便攜快充。
description_en: Xiaomi 20000mAh 67W Power Bank features a built-in USB-C cable with a clever storage slot—no more cable hassles! Delivers 67W max fast charging, juicing up a Xiaomi 15 to 67% in just 30 minutes. Supports 65W fast self-charging, reaching full capacity in about 2.5 hours. Equipped with 3 ports (built-in cable + USB-C + USB-A) to charge three devices simultaneously—phones, tablets, laptops, and more. Built with 3 high-quality cells, equivalent to 20000mAh (rated 12000mAh, 74.37Wh), and is flight-approved. The smart digital display shows precise battery percentage, charging status, and low-current mode at a glance. Supports PD3.0, QC3.5, and PPS protocols, compatible with Xiaomi, Huawei, Apple, Samsung, and more. Double-click the button for low-current mode to safely charge wearables like bands and earbuds. With 9-layer safety protection and dual NTC sensors for smart temperature control, it stays cool during fast charging. Compact and comfortable to hold. Perfect for travel, commuting

description_zh: 愛麗思 IRIS OHYAMA PCF-HD15空氣對流靜音循環風扇充分利用空氣動力學的風洞原理，並採用渦輪動力電機，從而做到空氣循環的效果！小小機身，既可吹出強勁涼風，亦可送出悠悠自然風！這把風扇配合暖風機和冷氣機一同使用，可做到冬季更暖和 / 夏季更涼爽！冬天和暖、春秋換氣、夏季涼爽、梅雨乾衣，一年四季也合用！十分細小，便於擺放。適用4坪空間節能省電可上下調整，左右自動擺動超靜音，只有風沒有聲音特殊設計集中強力渦漩氣流孩童安全設計，扇面縫隙小於9mm三階段風力：高、中、低一年四季皆適用

The PCF-HD15 is a compact but powerful fan capable of producing impressive air flow. When coupled with an air conditioning unit, the fan makes winters warmer and summers cooler, but it can be used during any season to improve ventilation. Its compact size means it is also easy to store.

description_en: The D10 Foldable Spray Handheld Fan combines powerful cooling with refreshing nano-mist. Its high-speed quiet motor operates at just 40dB, making it perfect for office, sleep, or outdoor use. Choose from 5 wind speeds (gentle to turbo), reaching up to 4.5m/s for instant relief. The fine mist adds a cooling hydration boost. Foldable design offers 110-degree tilt for optimal airflow, and it packs down compactly (90×95×53mm) to fit in any bag. Includes a soft lanyard for hands-free carrying, a 19ml water tank with easy refill, and Type-C charging. Lightweight and easy to hold. Available in White, Blue, and Purple. Ideal for commuting, hiking, and everyday use.

description_zh: 小米米家桌面移動風扇，一機兩用，解鎖清涼新方式！桌面/手持二合一設計，底盤直徑僅87mm、淨重0.67kg，輕巧便攜唔佔位，行企坐臥都涼快。內置4000mAh大容量電池，Type-C通用充電口，1檔不搖頭最長可用18.5小時，無線續航由早到晚都夠用。採用7羽仿生扇葉配合直流無刷電機，出風柔和細膩，送風幅面廣；運行噪音低至34dB(A)，辦公、學習、睡眠都唔怕嘈。支援90°垂直送風及左右90°自動擺頭，大廣角立體送風，涼風均勻覆蓋桌面空間。4檔風力調節，格栅網罩細密安全，可拆卸清洗。簡約純白機身，擺邊度都靚。無論辦公桌面、宿舍床頭、居家客廳定戶外休閒，都係你嘅隨身清涼伴侶。小米風扇、米家風扇、桌面風扇、手持風扇、移動風扇、無線風扇、充電風扇、靜音風扇、長續航風扇、辦公室風扇、宿舍風扇、便攜風扇、Type-C充電、7羽扇葉、自動搖頭。
description_en: The Mi Mijia Desktop Mobile Fan offers 2-in-1 versatility—use as a desktop fan or handheld. With a compact 87mm base and 0.67kg weight, it’s portable and space-saving. Powered by a 4000mAh battery with Type-C charging, it delivers up to 18.5 hours of use on low speed. The 7 bionic blades and brushless DC motor provide smooth, wide-angle airflow with noise as low as 34dB(A). Features 90° vertical tilt and 90° auto oscillation for even cooling. 4 speed settings, child-safe grille, and removable cover for easy cleaning. Sleek white design. Perfect for office, dorm, home, and outdoor.

description_en: The JISULIFE Life4 handheld fan delivers upgraded power and endurance. Its custom high-speed brushless motor and 12 aviation-grade turbine blades generate a powerful breeze up to 5.1m/s with 5 adjustable speeds. Weighing just 225g, it's ultra-portable with a lanyard. The removable rear grille makes cleaning easy. Built with 5 safety protections and a soft-touch ABS finish. Available in Misty Gray. Perfect for dorm, office, and outdoor use.

description_en: JISULIFE FA42 Plus turbo handheld fan delivers powerful airflow with AirTurbo multi-stage增压 technology and 7 wedge-shaped blades. Choose from 5 speeds, reaching up to 4.5m/s. Powered by a 4000mAh high-density battery with Type-C fast charging, it provides up to 15.5 hours of use on low speed. Noise reduction technology keeps operation at just 41dB. Compact and lightweight (82×43×167mm, 220g), it's perfect for travel and approved for flights. The world's No.1 USB fan brand for three consecutive years with over 670 patents. Available in Cloud White with matching lanyard. ﻿

Perfect for dorm, office, and outdoor use.

description_zh: 愛麗思 IRIS OHYAMA PCF-HD15空氣對流靜音循環風扇充分利用空氣動力學的風洞原理，並採用渦輪動力電機，從而做到空氣循環的效果！小小機身，既可吹出強勁涼風，亦可送出悠悠自然風！這把風扇配合暖風機和冷氣機一同使用，可做到冬季更暖和 / 夏季更涼爽！冬天和暖、春秋換氣、夏季涼爽、梅雨乾衣，一年四季也合用！十分細小，便於擺放。適用4坪空間節能省電可上下調整，左右自動擺動超靜音，只有風沒有聲音特殊設計集中強力渦漩氣流孩童安全設計，扇面縫隙小於9mm三階段風力：高、中、低一年四季皆適用
description_en: IRIS OHYAMA PCF-HD15 Silent Air Circulator Fan has a turbo motor that uses wind tunnel aerodynamics to achieve optimum air circulation. The PCF-HD15 is a compact but powerful fan capable of producing impressive air flow. When coupled with an air conditioning unit, the fan makes winters warmer and summers cooler, but it can be used during any season to improve ventilation. Its compact size means it is also easy to store.

description_zh: Kodak Snapic A1 現已登場!這款相機採用了三組玻璃鏡片,確保能呈現清晰、細緻的影像質感。加上配備了多種自動功能設計,包括自動上片、回片以及閃光燈,讓拍攝過程更加順暢。Snapic A1 擁有簡約的外觀配上低調的色系,完美展現現代流線型設計美學。無論是探索城市街頭還是享受大自然,其輕巧機身都方便攜帶,讓你隨時記錄每一個精彩瞬間。
description_en: This camera uses three sets of glass lenses to ensure clear, detailed image quality. Equipped with a variety of automatic functions—including automatic film loading, rewinding, and flash—it makes the shooting process smoother. Whether exploring city streets or enjoying nature, its lightweight body is easy to carry, allowing you to capture every exciting moment anytime.

description_en: Focal Bathys wireless headphones feature Bluetooth® 5.1 and Active Noise Cancellation. The headphones have 2 noise-canceling modes - 'Silent' for places with loud ambient noise, and 'Soft' for increased focus - and the technology is perfect for sound isolation. The headset also has a "transparency" mode, which allows users to perceive the surrounding ambient sound when necessary.

description_zh: 昂貴的化妝刷如何清洗？這是眾多妹紙們的難題。大創推出的化妝刷清洗液，相對之前的粉撲清洗液，更能有效清潔化妝刷上的汙垢，更加專業，可幫助輕鬆解決難題！清洗能力極強，化妝刷上沾染的各種深色化妝品，汙漬，都可極速清洗乾凈，清洗過程一分鐘都不要，快捷方便。清洗液含有保護刷毛的成份，清洗的同時，還可令動物毛質地的化妝刷毛得到保養。取少量清洗液倒於小容器內，將化妝刷毛放入液內清洗，不必用手，把刷毛在清潔液內稍用力來回刷按幾次即可，若刷上沾色太深，可拿出用紙巾把刷毛吸乾，再放入小容器內清洗幾次。然後用水沖洗乾淨，洗後用紙巾或者毛巾把刷毛上的清洗液吸乾，將化妝刷放置一邊（最好用化妝掃晾曬架），待刷毛全乾後，即可使用。

description_zh: 輕盈如雲朵，絲滑的觸感搭配Budd 背包的時尚外型，延續女性的優雅魅力。Budd 小文青背包襯托霧感4色，為這份嫻雅添上一陣柔和氣息。全新Budd 小背包 繼承Budd 系列外觀，採用Chapel 防水再生尼龍布，柔軟材質減少分明的棱角，在休閒中展現溫柔形象。考慮到女士的日常需求，Budd 小背包的內格設計簡潔，並改善了其餘層格的大小，亦將附軟墊的11吋平板電腦格層轉移到主格的另一面，善用主格層的所有空間。後幅的暗袋內置RFID防盜刷功能，貼身保護財物同時保障資料安全。這款優雅的女性都市背包提供兩種穿戴風格：上班時可以作為小背包使用，逛街時則用作手袋。Budd 小背包 升級女士的日常時尚，釋放奢華的柔美氣質。
description_en: Light as a cloud, with a silky smooth touch paired with the Budd backpack's stylish silhouette, continuing women's elegant charm. The Budd Mini Backpack complements the misty 4 colors, adding a soft aura to this refined grace.The all-new Budd Mini Backpack inherits the Budd series' exterior, adopting Chapel recycled nylon fabric, whose soft material softens sharp edges, revealing a gentle image amid casual vibes. Tailored to women's daily needs, the Budd Mini Backpack's interior compartments are designed concisely, with improved sizes for the remaining layers, and relocating the padded 11 inch tablet sleeve to the opposite side of the main compartment, making full use of all space in the main layer. The back panel's hidden pocket features built-in RFID anti-theft protection, safeguarding valuables close to the body while ensuring data security. This elegant urban women's backpack offers two wearing styles: use it as a mini backpack for work, or as a handbag for shopping.

description_zh: 輕盈如雲朵，絲滑的觸感搭配Budd 背包的時尚外型，延續女性的優雅魅力。Budd 小文青背包襯托霧感4色，為這份嫻雅添上一陣柔和氣息。全新Budd 小背包 繼承Budd 系列外觀，採用Chapel 防水再生尼龍布，柔軟材質減少分明的棱角，在休閒中展現溫柔形象。考慮到女士的日常需求，Budd 小背包的內格設計簡潔，並改善了其餘層格的大小，亦將附軟墊的11吋平板電腦格層轉移到主格的另一面，善用主格層的所有空間。後幅的暗袋內置RFID防盜刷功能，貼身保護財物同時保障資料安全。這款優雅的女性都市背包提供兩種穿戴風格：上班時可以作為小背包使用，逛街時則用作手袋。Budd 小背包 升級女士的日常時尚，釋放奢華的柔美氣質。
description_en: Light as a cloud, with a silky smooth touch paired with the Budd backpack's stylish silhouette, continuing women's elegant charm. The Budd Mini Backpack complements the misty 4 colors, adding a soft aura to this refined grace.The all-new Budd Mini Backpack inherits the Budd series' exterior, adopting Chapel recycled nylon fabric, whose soft material softens sharp edges, revealing a gentle image amid casual vibes. Tailored to women's daily needs, the Budd Mini Backpack's interior compartments are designed concisely, with improved sizes for the remaining layers, and relocating the padded 11 inch tablet sleeve to the opposite side of the main compartment, making full use of all space in the main layer. The back panel's hidden pocket features built-in RFID anti-theft protection, safeguarding valuables close to the body while ensuring data security. This elegant urban women's backpack offers two wearing styles: use it as a mini backpack for work, or as a handbag for shopping.

description_zh: 輕盈如雲朵，絲滑的觸感搭配Budd 背包的時尚外型，延續女性的優雅魅力。Budd 小文青背包襯托霧感4色，為這份嫻雅添上一陣柔和氣息。全新Budd 小背包 繼承Budd 系列外觀，採用Chapel 防水再生尼龍布，柔軟材質減少分明的棱角，在休閒中展現溫柔形象。考慮到女士的日常需求，Budd 小背包的內格設計簡潔，並改善了其餘層格的大小，亦將附軟墊的11吋平板電腦格層轉移到主格的另一面，善用主格層的所有空間。後幅的暗袋內置RFID防盜刷功能，貼身保護財物同時保障資料安全。這款優雅的女性都市背包提供兩種穿戴風格：上班時可以作為小背包使用，逛街時則用作手袋。Budd 小背包 升級女士的日常時尚，釋放奢華的柔美氣質。
description_en: Light as a cloud, with a silky smooth touch paired with the Budd backpack's stylish silhouette, continuing women's elegant charm. The Budd Mini Backpack complements the misty 4 colors, adding a soft aura to this refined grace.The all-new Budd Mini Backpack inherits the Budd series' exterior, adopting Chapel recycled nylon fabric, whose soft material softens sharp edges, revealing a gentle image amid casual vibes. Tailored to women's daily needs, the Budd Mini Backpack's interior compartments are designed concisely, with improved sizes for the remaining layers, and relocating the padded 11 inch tablet sleeve to the opposite side of the main compartment, making full use of all space in the main layer. The back panel's hidden pocket features built-in RFID anti-theft protection, safeguarding valuables close to the body while ensuring data security. This elegant urban women's backpack offers two wearing styles: use it as a mini backpack for work, or as a handbag for shopping.

description_zh: 輕盈如雲朵，絲滑的觸感搭配Budd 背包的時尚外型，延續女性的優雅魅力。Budd 小文青背包襯托霧感4色，為這份嫻雅添上一陣柔和氣息。全新Budd 小背包 繼承Budd 系列外觀，採用Chapel 防水再生尼龍布，柔軟材質減少分明的棱角，在休閒中展現溫柔形象。考慮到女士的日常需求，Budd 小背包的內格設計簡潔，並改善了其餘層格的大小，亦將附軟墊的11吋平板電腦格層轉移到主格的另一面，善用主格層的所有空間。後幅的暗袋內置RFID防盜刷功能，貼身保護財物同時保障資料安全。這款優雅的女性都市背包提供兩種穿戴風格：上班時可以作為小背包使用，逛街時則用作手袋。Budd 小背包 升級女士的日常時尚，釋放奢華的柔美氣質。
description_en: Light as a cloud, with a silky smooth touch paired with the Budd backpack's stylish silhouette, continuing women's elegant charm. The Budd Mini Backpack complements the misty 4 colors, adding a soft aura to this refined grace.The all-new Budd Mini Backpack inherits the Budd series' exterior, adopting Chapel recycled nylon fabric, whose soft material softens sharp edges, revealing a gentle image amid casual vibes. Tailored to women's daily needs, the Budd Mini Backpack's interior compartments are designed concisely, with improved sizes for the remaining layers, and relocating the padded 11 inch tablet sleeve to the opposite side of the main compartment, making full use of all space in the main layer. The back panel's hidden pocket features built-in RFID anti-theft protection, safeguarding valuables close to the body while ensuring data security. This elegant urban women's backpack offers two wearing styles: use it as a mini backpack for work, or as a handbag for shopping.
